title: [MPRaws] Ogenki Clinic (お元気クリニック) - DVDrip 684x572 h264
description:
This... This was something. Well, first of all, yes, this IS the complete OVA series, with the japanese audio track for all episodes. Unfortunately, in exchange for the complete JP track, we received a lot of... weird stuff.

First thing is that this is an old PAL DVD, so the framerate is really fucky and tends to blend too much. As I mentioned on the DVDISO release here on Sukebei, this "La Clinica Dell'amore" DVD was released by Doki Doki. Remember Kitty, from Media Blasters? Doki Doki would be practically the same, but for the italian Yamato Video.

Second that, for some unfortunate reason, the video quality is extremely unstable, and I'm not speaking of encoding, but for the actual SOURCE of the video. It really looks like Doki Doki used different sources for different chapters/"episodes", so sometimes we would have small black bars, and sometimes, we would have scenes with weird, pink/reddish colors that look like they were sourced from a bootleg. You may notice that this video has a weird number for a frame size (684x572, when PAL is usually 720x576). That's because I had to crop a lot of black stuff (no racism intended). 684x572 was the frame size I achieved removing most of the bars without actually removing bits of the animation frame. I configured a 4:3 DAR on the video after that, for it to display like it was intended, 4:3.

Another thing is that this release also edited some stuff. Besides the episodes cards, in the original japanese form, we would have openings and endings for each OVA episode release (three, here), but since this DVD just gathers everything in a single 2 hour video, there is just one opening and one ending, both in their correct places but with edited credits, the italian logo of the series, and such stuff. I thought "2 hours may be a bit too long for the casual hentai watcher", so I made chapters for all the 12 episodes, plus the intro and ending credits.

With this said, I also need to mention that I know there are subs for the OVA, but there are two problems: 1) They're ancient. 2) I think they're long lost, because I couldn't find them anywhere, neither on the hentai websites nor Sukebei. That's why I'll be releasing this as a raw encode, with the japanese and italian audio tracks (yeah, I'm including the italian track even when it's MONO, stfu). Feel free to sub this, I think it's a neat OVA and at some point, an interesting piece of "hentai history". Now, back to my doujins.

title: Fate/stay night [Réalta Nua] Ultimate Edition (v1.1.3)
description:
![](https://i.postimg.cc/0jnQm2zh/Version-Info.png)

- Full game, preinstalled as 'portable'.
- Contains all patches except for the ultra high res ones (2400 and 3200) that are considered unstable. If desired, these can be downloaded from the MEGA link in the forum (https://forums.nrvnqsr.com/showthread.php/9101). Note that those should be used with "Fate64.exe" exclusively - the 32-bit "Fate.exe" will crash in memory intensive scenes.
- Includes the full set of flowcharts by Poki#3.

Changelog v1.1.3:
- Fixed icon-related crash on Android Kirikiroid2 (reported by BOOP 2022-10-07).
- Fixed movie playback issue on SteamDeck (reported by vnrando 2022-10-16).
- Fixed english chapter title of "十四日目/フィナーレ" to "14th Day/Finale" (reported by Poki#3 on 2022-10-19).
- Fixed bug that prevented the mature version of scene "Intermission - Last Piece" from playing.
- Added missing japanese mature version of scene "Intermission - Last Piece".
- Fixed broken flag change popup when language is not Japanese (reported by Dimoks on 2022-10-22).
- Fixed issue that caused lost sprite animations in multiple scenes.
- Fixed crash when accessing the Movie menu on Android Kirikiroid2.
- Fixed issue that prevented Status menu Noble Phantasm icon text from showing on Android Kirikiroid2.
- Fixed issue that prevented the game from returning to the Title Menu after completing the Prologue for the first time.
- Fixed issue with noise effect coverage.
- Fixed many typos.
- Corrected errors in the descriptions of the japanese Weapon Menu (fix offered by Dimoks).
- Added more authentic fonts to japanese Weapon Menu (fix offered by Dimoks).
- Added more authentic fonts to japanese Status Menu.
- Added Poki#3's new flowchart.
- Added controller support on PC.
- Added test version of the English retranslation by FBates (beta ver. 2.0)



Note: v1.1.4 is out at https://sukebei.nyaa.si/view/3860991

她（柊瑞树）今天也在诊察室里低着头。
无论我再怎么询问着状况，她空虚晦暗的瞳孔也不为所动。
她以前隶属于学校里的啦啦队，灿烂的笑容和开朗的性格令人心动。
但是，那一切都一去不返。
——因为她被某个跟踪狂无情地强暴了，被夺走了一切。
作为精神科医生，我一定要治好崩溃的她…我如此坚信着。
———然后，数月之后———
她终于能像以前一样露出笑容了。
创伤康复伴随着难以想象的痛苦。
她需要无数次回想起将那时的场面，挣扎着直面过去。
她也曾无数次哭泣崩溃。
但是，她终于跨过去了。
那不是作为医生的我的力量，而是靠着她自己不懈的努力。
在诊断所的治疗也终于迎来了尾声。
——可是。
在她灿烂可爱的笑容面前，我作为医生不应有的一种想法在内心深处不断涌动着。
「不想和她分开。」
但随着治疗的结束，我就再也见不到她了啊。
该怎么办，到底该怎么办……
在我焦急之刻，一个残忍而汹涌的念头闪过我的脑海。
啊，对了……
只要用我的手，再次玷污她……
